verification.ci: GitHub API September 6: Quality 33940262401 successful for f1a924b6b53d393c5e256bd4e2a727c5e16ed35b; active Protect main ruleset, no environment returned.
verification.production: September 5–10 evidence: public health returns eight agents ready at revision f1a924b6b53d393c5e256bd4e2a727c5e16ed35b from the immutable Coolify container. Runtime exact proxy peers were configured; an external request resolved to the actual client IP and a forged X-Forwarded-For value did not replace it. Cloudflare returns the exact HTTPS redirect and HSTS max-age 63072000. Screenshots show active rule grela-expensive-public-api with a 20 requests per IP/10 seconds edge budget and 10-second block. The operator reports its current exact-host/POST expression in grela.dev and a Free-plan quota of one custom rate-limit rule; behavioral acceptance is not yet verified.

evidence.en: The weighted in-process limiter receives verified client identity. Active Cloudflare rule grela-expensive-public-api has a 20 requests per IP/10-second threshold and 10-second block; its operator-declared current expression scopes exact POST operations on both hosts. The Free-plan one-rule quota makes the shared edge budget intentional; behavior, proxy limits and shared state across overlapping replicas remain unverified.
evidence.pl: Ważony limiter procesu otrzymuje zweryfikowane IP klienta. Aktywna reguła Cloudflare grela-expensive-public-api ma próg 20 żądań per IP/10 s i blokadę 10 s; zadeklarowane bieżące wyrażenie ogranicza ją do dokładnych operacji POST na obu hostach. Limit jednej reguły w darmowym planie uzasadnia wspólny budżet edge; zachowanie, limity proxy i wspólny stan replik pozostają niezweryfikowane.
